summary: 13 features and 8 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claudehelper: support thinking-display setting for Claude CLI (cea1837)
  • omniroute: add connection resolver and settings surface (1e2918f)
  • sessions: add proposal content language to session creation (6ecc337)
  • web: refresh Claude secondary model catalog (f6db5e5)
  • web: add no-background-research constraint to openspec prompts (de0e505)
  • domainservices: add lightweight git dirty-flag probe (c93c60b)
  • claudehelper: add Claude Code effort field and deprecate thinkingMode (a052010)

HagiCode-org/web

  • omniroute: back settings with omniRoute config slice (769f3f4)
  • omniroute: add API key field and connection test (a76db27)
  • git: add recently changed remotes dropdown (cc65986)
  • git: replace diff panel with repository tracking summary (3f71da9)
  • hero: replace Claude thinkingMode with effort parameter (4758750)
  • git: add binary change marker for repository status (02e3bd3)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • domainservices: skip blank thinking blocks when mapping Claude messages (02ebbc1)
  • claudehelper: resume Claude Code conversation by id only (7041d5e)
  • claudehelper: keep Claude Code stream open across subagent turns (2384f34)
  • orleans: preserve provider event time for session messages (6443d2a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • messages: skip empty thinking blocks in rendering (4939d95)
  • session: move recent changed repos dropdown to right edge (48a9b35)
  • utils: make formatSmartTimestamp null-safe for invalid input (1771898)
  • signalr: keep first-seen message time and drop local-now fallback (fe28ff7)
